note: Reviewed public-source profiles and official portraits. Summaries are editorial reference descriptions; originalBioExcerpt is a short quotation when an accessible first-party bio exists.

watchlist-324.name: Jason Ricci
watchlist-324.summary: American harmonica performer, singer and teacher who tours with The Bad Kind. His channel shares harmonica lessons, live solos and equipment demonstrations.
watchlist-324.originalBioExcerpt: Harmonica Super Cat, Singer, Songwriter, Teacher, YouTuber, Speaker.
watchlist-324.activityEvidence: Recent upload verified directly from official YouTube Atom feed.

watchlist-325.name: Roly Platt
watchlist-325.summary: Canadian session harmonica player and teacher, and creator of the Harp Wah. He shares performances, lessons and tools for harmonica tablature and transcription.
watchlist-325.originalBioExcerpt: Canadian session harmonica player and inventor/creator of the Harp Wah.
watchlist-325.activityEvidence: Recent upload verified directly from official YouTube Atom feed.

watchlist-326.name: Ronnie Shellist
watchlist-326.summary: Blues harmonica performer and teacher behind Harmonica123. His lessons and videos cover bending, tone, improvisation and blues repertoire, with live online classes.
watchlist-326.originalBioExcerpt: Straight forward, blues focused harmonica instruction.
watchlist-326.activityEvidence: Recent upload verified directly from official YouTube Atom feed.

watchlist-327.name: Joe Filisko
watchlist-327.summary: Chicago-based blues harmonica player, teacher and customizer. His study songs and videos explore traditional styles, rhythm, chording and ensemble playing.
watchlist-327.originalBioExcerpt: Here's some various stuff that I have done for fun along with some ensemble stuff.
watchlist-327.activityEvidence: Recent upload verified directly from official YouTube Atom feed.

watchlist-328.name: Dennis Gruenling
watchlist-328.summary: American blues harmonica performer and teacher behind BadAss Harmonica. He records and tours with the Nick Moss Band and shares lessons, webinars and vintage microphone demonstrations.
watchlist-328.originalBioExcerpt: As a performer and instructor of 30 years, I have helped students from around the world learn the language of blues harmonica
watchlist-328.activityEvidence: Recent upload verified directly from official YouTube Atom feed.

watchlist-329.name: Adam Gussow
watchlist-329.summary: American blues harmonica performer and teacher behind Modern Blues Harmonica. His active classic-blues channel shares lessons and performances for beginners through advanced players.
watchlist-329.originalBioExcerpt: Here you'll find a fresh and engaging series of blues harmonica instructional videos designed to answer both basic beginner questions
watchlist-329.activityEvidence: Recent upload verified directly from official YouTube Atom feed.

watchlist-330.name: David Barrett
watchlist-330.summary: American blues harmonica teacher, performer and author who founded BluesHarmonica.com and Harmonica Masterclass. His courses cover technique, tongue blocking, improvisation and musicianship.
watchlist-330.originalBioExcerpt: Since age eighteen, David has been teaching blues harmonica lessons full-time.
watchlist-330.activityEvidence: 2026-08-27 answer by David Barrett on his official forum; YouTube latest is 2023, so do not imply frequent uploads.

watchlist-331.name: Michael Rubin
watchlist-331.summary: Austin-based harmonica performer, recording musician and teacher. He offers private and online lessons and a free video archive focused on music theory and harmonica technique.
watchlist-331.originalBioExcerpt: Gigs, studio sessions, private lessons, and nearly 100 free theory lessons on YouTube.
watchlist-331.activityEvidence: Named performer at SPAH 2026 convention, August 11-15; own YouTube latest is 2024, so not a frequent uploader.

watchlist-332.name: Todd Parrott
watchlist-332.summary: North Carolina harmonica performer and teacher whose playing draws on blues, gospel and country. He offers online lessons and organizes the Carolina Harp Fest.
watchlist-332.originalBioExcerpt: I've been playing harmonica for more than 35 years. I use Hohner Golden Melody harmonicas, customized by Joe Spiers.
watchlist-332.activityEvidence: Upcoming event: official Carolina Harp Fest site advertises October 15–17, 2026. This is a future event as of verification on 2026-09-28, not a completed appearance. Latest verified YouTube upload is from 2024.

watchlist-333.name: Carlos del Junco
watchlist-333.summary: Canadian harmonica performer and teacher who uses overblows to play chromatically on the ten-hole diatonic harmonica. His official site offers recordings, performance videos, lessons and session work.
watchlist-333.originalBioExcerpt: I am doing a series of online webinars on all things about harmonica practice and teaching privately.
watchlist-333.activityEvidence: Current teaching/session offerings, but no dated 2026 activity verified on the artist site; do not label frequent uploader.

watchlist-334.name: Will Wilde
watchlist-334.summary: British blues-rock harmonica player, singer and songwriter. His channel shares live performances, music videos and harmonica lessons, while his official site lists touring and recordings.
watchlist-334.originalBioExcerpt: British Blues Rock Harmonica Player, Singer & Songwriter.
watchlist-334.activityEvidence: YouTube feed: full Augustibluus concert published 2026-09-25; slow-blues performance published 2026-09-23.

watchlist-335.name: Tomlin Leckie
watchlist-335.summary: Scotland-based blues harmonica player and teacher, and founder of Tomlin Harmonica School. His lessons cover beginner skills, blues phrasing, improvisation and practice, with regular video lessons and student questions.
watchlist-335.originalBioExcerpt: I currently live in Scotland where I play and teach music full-time.
watchlist-335.activityEvidence: YouTube feed: Ask Tomlin lesson 2026-09-21; 12-bar blues lesson 2026-09-16. Official teacher bio explicitly states full-time music teaching/playing.

watchlist-336.name: Jean-Jacques Milteau
watchlist-336.summary: French harmonica musician whose recordings explore blues, soul, country and folk traditions. His official channel combines performances with practical harmonica demonstrations, and his site documents albums and instructional publications.
watchlist-336.originalBioExcerpt: Milteau a su traduire le monde en mettant sa virtuosité au service de l’émotion pure.
watchlist-336.activityEvidence: YouTube feed: 8 Bars Blues 2026-09-17; Valse Musette on a C harmonica 2026-08-30.

watchlist-337.name: Mathias Heise
watchlist-337.summary: Danish chromatic harmonica player, composer and arranger. His work spans acoustic jazz, fusion with Mathias Heise Quadrillion, and large-ensemble projects, with performance videos and recordings available through his official channels.
watchlist-337.originalBioExcerpt: Chromatic harmonica-player and composer from Denmark.
watchlist-337.activityEvidence: YouTube feed: Mathias Heise Orchestra - Calling 2026-09-17. Official site lists 2026 albums Repertoire and A Love Supreme.

watchlist-338.name: Hermine Deurloo
watchlist-338.summary: Dutch chromatic harmonica player with a lyrical jazz sound. Her projects include recordings and performances with Steve Gadd, small jazz groups and orchestras; her official channel shares concert performances and original music.
watchlist-338.originalBioExcerpt: Hermine studied saxophone at the Amsterdam Conservatory while, at the same time, teaching herself to play the harmonica.
watchlist-338.activityEvidence: Official-site embedded Riverbeast video identifies her channel. YouTube feed: Lied van Alle Dagen 2026-05-08; Pastéis de Nata 2026-03-30.

watchlist-339.name: Will Pound
watchlist-339.summary: British harmonica and melodeon player whose work connects folk traditions with new collaborations. His projects include solo and band recordings, folk dance music, and Stevens & Pound with percussionist Delia Stevens.
watchlist-339.originalBioExcerpt: Triple BBC award nominee Will Pound is a professional harmonica and session musician based in the UK.
watchlist-339.activityEvidence: Current Stevens & Pound official site promotes 2027 touring and recent orchestral projects. Exact recent social publication date not established; do not call a frequent uploader.

watchlist-340.name: Sébastien Charlier
watchlist-340.summary: French diatonic harmonica player working across jazz, rock and fusion. His projects include the Precious Time recordings, collaborations and harmonica workshops, alongside instructional books and technical demonstrations.
watchlist-340.originalBioExcerpt: Des extraits audio de plusieurs albums sont d’ores et déjà disponibles, ainsi que de nombreuses vidéos.
watchlist-340.activityEvidence: Official site lists 2026-10-16 Yelloworld concert and October workshops; exact recent social publishing date not established.

watchlist-341.name: Lee Sankey
watchlist-341.summary: British blues harmonica musician and educator whose channel covers beginner to advanced techniques, tongue blocking and musical phrasing, alongside live performances and original music.
watchlist-341.originalBioExcerpt: My channel provides lessons for the blues harmonica covering basic to advanced techniques and ideas.
watchlist-341.activityEvidence: Latest public YouTube feed entry 2025-11-30, so classify established educator with intermittent uploads, not recently frequent.

watchlist-342.name: Amanda Ventura
watchlist-342.summary: Brazilian blues harmonica player and online teacher. Her channel shares expressive diatonic harmonica performances, short videos and play-along tablature, including her original solo “The Way.”
watchlist-342.activityEvidence: 2026-08-28 official upload verified. Country corroborated by festival programme. Online teaching is explicit; full-time status not established.

watchlist-343.name: Gabriel Grossi
watchlist-343.summary: Brazilian harmonica player, composer and producer whose projects span jazz, Brazilian music, pop and classical repertoire. His official channel shares concerts, collaborations and behind-the-scenes videos, including recent Hermeto Universal performances.
watchlist-343.originalBioExcerpt: Confira também atualizações no site: http://www.gabrielgrossi.com
watchlist-343.activityEvidence: Official website crosslinks all listed social accounts. Professional career established, no unsupported full-time label.

watchlist-344.name: Mariano Massolo
watchlist-344.summary: Buenos Aires harmonica performer and teacher focused on gypsy swing, jazz and blues. He directs the International Harmonica Institute and offers structured online lessons, alongside recordings and concert performances.
watchlist-344.originalBioExcerpt: Online Harmonica Lessons with gypsy swing master Mariano Massolo
watchlist-344.activityEvidence: Official YouTube feed latest upload is 2024-07-21, so do not call frequent/current video poster. SPAH official 2025 programme documents performance and teaching career.

watchlist-345.name: Mitch Grainger
watchlist-345.summary: Australian blues and roots musician, harmonica educator and inventor of the Dyna-Mic microphone. His English-language videos combine performances with practical lessons on tone, phrasing, country harmonica and beginner techniques.
watchlist-345.originalBioExcerpt: This is where my two biggest passions come together: making music and teaching harmonica.
watchlist-345.activityEvidence: Australian origin; career also based in USA. Exact current residence not verified. Official site crosslinks all listed social accounts. Channel title currently misspells Grainger as Granger; retain correct artist spelling.

watchlist-346.name: Franco Luciani
watchlist-346.summary: Argentine chromatic harmonica player, composer and singer whose repertoire connects tango and folk traditions with jazz and classical music. His official channel includes performances and the collection Ten Short Pieces for Chromatic Harmonica.
watchlist-346.activityEvidence: No self-written channel bio present, so editorial summary is based on official Suzuki artist page and government venue. Old francoluciani.com.ar does not resolve: use live official artist page. Suzuki video link resolved via YouTube oEmbed to verified channel. Latest upload 2026-09-25.

watchlist-347.name: Pablo Fagundes
watchlist-347.summary: Brasília harmonica player and educator working with both chromatic and diatonic instruments. He brings Brazilian choro, jazz and blues into performances and teaching, and developed a chromatic harmonica course at the Choro Club of Brasília.
watchlist-347.activityEvidence: Official channel has no self-bio. Editorial summary based on Suzuki and official CIVEBRA course bio. Old pablofagundes.com.br does not resolve. Public channel content identifies harmonica work and same repertoire; Facebook account independently crosslinked by Suzuki. Latest upload 2026-07-20.

watchlist-348.name: Chris Maunders
watchlist-348.summary: Melbourne chromatic harmonica performer, recording artist and tutor. He founded Harp’s a Breeze, a school harmonica programme using ten-hole diatonic instruments, and combines jazz performance with music education.
watchlist-348.originalBioExcerpt: Chris Maunders now balances a healthy schedule as a versatile full-time performer, recording artist and harmonica tutor
watchlist-348.activityEvidence: Full-time explicitly stated on own programme bio. Official school social accounts are programme accounts, not personal, so omitted to avoid conflation. 2026-06-22 The Talent episode appearance found on producer platform; latest directly dated album 2023-11-22. Portrait is him playing harmonica, with another musician partially visible in background.

watchlist-349.name: Rohan Singhal
watchlist-349.summary: Harmonica player and singer from Indore, India, combining blues with Indian classical ragas. His official site shares performances, and SPAH’s 2026 programme lists his session explaining and playing Indian raga music.
watchlist-349.originalBioExcerpt: Known for blending the soul of blues with the depth of Indian ragas
watchlist-349.activityEvidence: SPAH 2026 seminar on Saturday 2026-08-15. Current official site YouTube channel link unavailable and prior @rohansinghal712 handle 404; omit broken YouTube URL. Professional/full-time status not asserted. Image depicts artist playing on his official About section.

watchlist-350.name: Christelle Berthon
watchlist-350.summary: French diatonic harmonica performer known for expressive melodic interpretations. Her official channel shares blues, song arrangements and instrument demonstrations, spanning repertoire from popular melodies to classical music.
watchlist-350.activityEvidence: YouTube profile country field currently France. Official feed: Trochilus Blues 2026-05-03; La Dispute 2026-04-09. Verified artist/video resource, no claim of weekly activity or full-time work.

watchlist-351.name: Håkan Ehn
watchlist-351.summary: Swedish harmonica creator also known as Harmonica Hawk. His self-taught approach is reflected in blues, boogie and rock performances, practical technique videos and instrument experiments; his channel describes harmonica as a hobby.
watchlist-351.originalBioExcerpt: My name is Håkan Ehn and playing harmonica is my hobby.
watchlist-351.activityEvidence: Official YouTube country field Sweden. Feed published harmonica videos 2026-09-25, 2026-09-11, 2026-08-30; strong recent activity. Explicitly hobbyist, not full-time musician.

watchlist-352.name: Greg Zlap
watchlist-352.summary: Polish-born, France-based harmonica performer and session musician. His work connects blues and rock with chanson and electronic collaborations, and his official channel shares concert clips, collaborations and music videos.
watchlist-352.originalBioExcerpt: Bienvenue sur la chaîne officielle YouTube de Greg Zlap !
watchlist-352.activityEvidence: Official channel latest feed 2025-12-29, three performance Shorts. Hohner artist profile establishes professional session and touring roles. No assertion of frequent recent uploads; gregzlap.fr and .com unavailable, so website intentionally blank.

watchlist-353.name: Max De Aloe
watchlist-353.summary: Italian chromatic harmonica player, composer and educator. He combines jazz performance with teaching at his music school, writes harmonica methods, and shares concerts and demonstrations through his official ChromaticHarmonica channel.
watchlist-353.activityEvidence: Official calendar lists 2026-09-27 concert with Paolo Fresu and Roberto Olzer, plus future October/November 2026 shows. YouTube performance published 2026-04-19. School-embedded lesson videos verify channel ID UCLYKnK8gjvY8RvR7MvN5Kuw; @ChromaticHarmonica without trailing 1 belongs to another person and MUST NOT be used.

watchlist-354.name: Ariel Bart
watchlist-354.summary: Berlin-based chromatic harmonica player and composer. Her original music explores contemporary jazz and a trio setting with cello and piano; her official channels share recordings and live performances, including the album After Silence.
watchlist-354.activityEvidence: Official Bandcamp locates artist in Berlin, Germany (country here is operating base, not asserted nationality). Official homepage album After Silence released 2025-09-19. YouTube Nine Souls live at Bauer Studios published 2026-01-24. Official website directly links verified YouTube, Facebook, Instagram.

watchlist-355.name: Sarah Saputri
watchlist-355.summary: Indonesian singer, songwriter and harmonica player from Bandung, and a SEYDEL artist. Her videos combine blues, country, Sundanese and popular music with diatonic harmonica tutorials, including lessons on Ayun Ambing.
watchlist-355.activityEvidence: Official YouTube avatar depicts Sarah playing harmonica with channel branding. Channel metadata directly confirms singer, Indonesian player, SEYDEL endorser and exact Facebook/Instagram URLs. Latest official upload 2026-08-12; two actual harmonica tutorials 2026-05-16 and 2026-05-22. Do not label full-time without explicit evidence.

watchlist-356.name: Subham Mukherjee / SoundBazz
watchlist-356.summary: Indian harmonica educator and founder of SoundBazz and Harmonica Pathshala in Suri, West Bengal. His channel offers lessons, Bollywood covers, instrument reviews and community updates; his studio also provides harmonica customization and repairs.
watchlist-356.originalBioExcerpt: #Soundbazz_Harmonica_Pathshala it’s a channel made for the Harmonica or mouth organ lovers.
watchlist-356.activityEvidence: Official website embeds lesson Aa2mV3riOx4; YouTube oEmbed resolves author to @subhamsinstrumental5152, whose self-bio links back to soundbazz.com and verified Facebook URL. Latest official upload 2026-09-23. Portrait is official channel avatar, clearly him playing harmonica. IMPORTANT: @SoundBazz and @SubhamMukherjee are unrelated old channels; do not import them or their assets.

watchlist-357.name: Justin Brady
watchlist-357.summary: Australian harmonica player and multi-instrumentalist known for Things of Stone and Wood. He runs Off the Lip Australian Harmonica School, offers lessons in Melbourne, Mallacoota and online, and leads workshops for schools, festivals and community groups.
watchlist-357.originalBioExcerpt: Justin teaches harmonica students of all ages and abilities.
watchlist-357.activityEvidence: Portrait from his official Listen page depicts Justin alone with mandolin and a harmonica neck holder; chosen instead of duo/group photos. Official site crosslinks Facebook. Dated organiser ticket page verifies 2025-08-09 harmonica/mandolin performance. Current lesson offers verified; no recent video frequency claim. YouTube embeds on own site belong to collaborators/fans, so no personal YouTube channel added.

watchlist-358.name: Dave Ferguson
watchlist-358.summary: Cape Town performer also known as Lonesome Dave. His solo shows build live loops from harmonica, beatboxing and vocals, combining original material with blues and Americana; he also works as a live and studio harmonica player.
watchlist-358.activityEvidence: Photo is actual official SoundCloud profile avatar (harmonica tattoo, not face), account crosslinked by official organiser Quicket event. Artist portrait alternative available at /tmp/harmonica-expansion-20260928/global/images/1d6122c9d93af284df28.webp from official Harpin by the Sea festival page. Both Facebook login shell and SoundCloud null description prevent self-bio retrieval; editorial bio from booking agency/festival, NOT self-written. 2025-10-10 first-person interview confirms continuing performances at Voorkamerfest 2025, but no current post frequency claim.

watchlist-359.name: Nita Das
watchlist-359.summary: Indian chromatic harmonica teacher offering individual online lessons through ipassio. Her beginner, intermediate and advanced courses cover breathing, instrument handling and playing technique, with instruction available in English, Bengali, Hindi and Marathi.
watchlist-359.activityEvidence: Optional directory-first candidate: active purchasable course/profile observed 2026-09-28, but no publication/activity date or personal social channel verified. Portrait is her actual teacher profile photo on teaching platform. Bio is platform course/profile-based editorial summary, not self-written social bio; no full-time or frequent video claim.
